method: AI-assisted reading of official HKUST and SIT sources; no independent human review, application submission or live application-session check. SIT guide was read as complete two-page extracted text only; screenshot requests failed and a direct download returned an HTML challenge, not a usable PDF.

hkust.academic: Recognised bachelor/equivalent; second-class honours or above in Civil Engineering or related engineering. Relatedness, equivalence and non-Civil Engineering remedial courses need university judgement.

english.manualAlternatives: English-first-language or English-medium bachelor/equivalent waiver, TOEFL pBT 550 or revised paper-delivered 60

hkust.feeExceptions: Ordinary MSc credit transfer still pays full tuition; additional/retaken courses cost extra. The HKUST integrated Bachelor-Master pathway has separate conditional admission, prior-credit and minimum-21-credit pro-rata rules.

meng.transfer: Current MSc students only, after first-year MSc requirements and approval for year-long industrial placement

hkust.decision: Keep stable MSc mode IDs while explicitly updating cohort from directly read 2027/28 sources. Add two separately fingerprint-bound applicant contexts with four category options. Leave opening/time unknown, no default category, no visa determination. Retain the separate older MEng archival record unchanged; new source notes do not restamp its 2026 record.

duration.decision: Keep source discrepancy for confirmation, not an additive duration

sit.academic: Programme specifies accredited Civil Engineering bachelor, central engineering page says Engineering/equivalent. One year of relevant post-bachelor experience includes SIT IWSP; equivalence, relevance and timing remain manual.

english.guideTextScope: International bachelor qualification not taught in English
english.validity: Two years before application submission, not today
english.decision: Keep all newly captured guide thresholds/alternatives manual pending visual and applicability confirmation; no new automated language rule or automatic English-medium waiver

fees.decision: Examples stay labelled undated, not imported as a January 2027 or international quote. Cohort/subsidy, prior subsidised postgraduate qualifications, professional recognition, GST and separate miscellaneous charges need confirmation.

sit.delivery: Weekday evening classes; ten coursework modules or eight plus an industrial dissertation subject to good academic standing. Dissertation option is not research-entry classification.
sit.decision: Keep IDs, January intake and past cutoff; add explicit opening. Do not invent extension, next intake, numeric GPA, category pricing or programme-specific eligibility from generic wording.
